tokens.note: Wix-built corporate site. primary = navy ink #1a2352 that anchors every section heading; #046cb8 is the achievement/eyebrow blue. Product surfaces (Moonlight) run a night-time deep-purple #402060 + cream #fff3b7 theme. Headings use a custom uploaded display webfont; body/UI resolve to Pretendard + Wix Madefor.
